name: GChat Preview Files
description: Read .html, .md and .json attachments right inside Google Chat — no download, no leaving the tab. Diagrams and JSON trees included.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; media-src data: blob:; font-src data:; frame-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'
